statement: The system shall support participants obtaining an ISIN issued, amended, or removed.

The system shall be efficient enough to support same-day trading, clearing, and settlement.
The system shall provide turnaround times measured in minutes rather than hours or days.
The system shall significantly reduce manual handling.
The system shall maintain strong control over records.
The system shall keep market data accurate, auditable, and reliable.

STRATE shall serve as the submission and routing channel for ISIN requests and pass them through in the agreed format.
